newsitem.title: USA: BankUnited sees $2 bln in assets yr end.
newsitem.headline: BankUnited sees $2 bln in assets yr end.

text.p: BankUnited Financial Corp said on Wednesday that it expects assets to top $2 billion by the end of 1997 through new branch openings and strong growth from residential mortgages and commercial real estate.
During the past year, BankUnited, which is based in southern Florida, has doubled in size through the pursuit of aggressive expansion in the region and its acquisition of Suncoast Savings and Loan.
The company plans to open three or four new offices in 1997, it said.
At the end of its fiscal year on September 30, 1996, BankUnited had $824.4 million in assets.
